ImageDescription.value: The entrance to the Miraflores locks of the Panama Canal.  This jetty separates the two side-by-side locks of the canal.  The arrow with the green arrowhead tells the pilot whether to enter the set of locks to the left or the right.  At night the arrow is lit by neon - the first neon lighting installed in Central America.
